'''Jhonterius''' was the founder of the city of [[D'larah]] on the planet [[Demophon]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] a mysterious figure frequenting [[Jhonterius Park]] claimed to be his [[Ghost of Jhonterius Park|ghost]].<ref name="TC" />
